sections.Profile:
"Boot-A-Ball," released by Bally Manufacturing Co. in June 1967, is a distinctive head-to-head, soccer-themed pinball machine designed by Ted Zale.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1966–1967
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Soccer, Head-to-Head, Sports, Original Theme

- Design: Ted Zale
